terms: Section 5 prohibits bots, scripts, scrapers, crawlers, data-mining tools and internal endpoint access.
Section 7 prohibits copying, modifying, distributing or creating derivatives of platform technology without written permission.
Generated exports may include a license for controlled template elements, but that does not license project-source redistribution.
policyBoundary.decision: Do not bulk-download or clone Motionvid projects. Build original OmniFrame recipes from general motion-design techniques.
